name: memoriagraph
title: MemoriaGraph 3.0
description: The Biomimetic Cognitive Substrate & Architectural Triad for AI Pair Programmers. Provides 4-Way Hybrid Recall, Dynamic Belief Revision, Anti-Slop Semantic Sanitization, and Git Blast-Radius Mapping backed by Neo4j.

tools.name: retain
tools.description: Biomimetic unified ingestion gateway for episodes, heuristics, or observations into specific memory banks.

tools.name: recall
tools.description: 4-Way Hybrid Search (BM25 + Multi-hop Graph + Temporal + Int8 Dense Vector) with Reciprocal Rank Fusion.

tools.name: reflect
tools.description: Synthesizes cross-episode lessons, extracts heuristics, and manages belief confidence.

tools.name: query_dss
tools.description: Decision Support System query for historical precedents, tradeoff rationales, and past incident outcomes.

tools.name: list_cognitive_beliefs
tools.description: Retrieves active beliefs, heuristics, and crystallized patterns ranked by confidence score.

tools.name: reinforce_belief_tool
tools.description: Strengthens a cognitive belief upon positive confirmation using logarithmic dampening.

tools.name: challenge_belief_tool
tools.description: Weakens a cognitive belief upon unexpected failure using a resilient hysteresis formula.

tools.name: record_code_action
tools.description: Codebase-Memory anchor that maps git blast-radius, modified modules, and touched functions into Neo4j.

tools.name: get_cognitive_dashboard
tools.description: Retrieves cognitive metrics, exploration pipelines, and decision constraint frequencies.

tools.name: get_context
tools.description: Retrieves comprehensive contextual graph around entities, decisions, and problem constraints.

tools.name: record_cognitive_episode
tools.description: Records full multi-attempt problem-solving trajectories into Neo4j.

tools.name: log_event
tools.description: Appends an immutable audit event to the monthly append-only event stream.

tools.name: add_entity
tools.description: Adds or updates an individual domain entity node with properties and memory bank assignment.

tools.name: add_relation
tools.description: Creates typed directional relationships between knowledge graph entities.
